name: Allure Report
summary: Test reports with steps, attachments, history and flaky-test markers, with adapters for most test frameworks.
strengths: Step-level detail with screenshots, traces and logs attached.
History and trends across runs show flaky tests.
Adapters for JUnit, pytest, Playwright, Cypress, WebdriverIO and more.
tradeoffs: Another tool to host and keep in CI.
Rich reports depend on teams annotating steps.
